title: Compositional Embedding Architecture for Physical Field Prediction in Componentized Aerospace Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.00237v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spacecraft thermal design requires repeated evaluation of how variations in the number and spatial arrangement of heat-generating components and in thermal boundary conditions affect the temperature field. High-fidelity numerical simulations are computationally expensive and therefore difficult to use for large-scale design screening. Although surrogate models can accelerate temperature-field prediction, existing approaches generally encode each complete configuration as a whole and do not explicitly exploit the reusability of local physical constituents across configurations, which limits their accuracy for component counts and combinations not covered during training. translated_title: 面向组件化航天系统的物理场预测的组合式嵌入架构
translated_abstract: 航天器热设计需要反复评估发热部件的数量与空间排布变化以及热边界条件变化对温度场的影响。高精度数值模拟计算代价高昂，因此难以用于大规模设计筛选。尽管代理模型可以加速温度场预测，但现有方法通常将每个完整构型作为一个整体进行编码，未显式利用局部物理组成部分在不同构型间的可复用性，这限制了模型在训练中未覆盖的部件数量与组合情况下的精度。为解决这一问题，我们提出了树结构因子组合网络（TFCN），它将复杂的航天器热构型分解为可复用的局部物理因子，并采用树结构组合模块来学习全局温度场。
tldr: 提出树结构因子组合网络（TFCN），将航天器热构型分解为可复用的局部物理因子并通过树结构组合模块学习全局温度场，从而提升组件化航天系统温度场预测的精度与泛化能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Tree-Structured Factor Composition Network (TFCN), which decomposes spacecraft thermal configurations into reusable local physical factors and employs a tree-structured composition module to learn the global temperature field, improving accuracy and generalization for physical field prediction in componentized aerospace systems.
